# GMEOW Expertise Module

The GMEOW Expertise Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/expertise>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/expertise`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Skills, occupations and credentials (the schema.org / ESCO / CTDL / O*NET / SOC superset layer). SKOS concepts are reused as recommended value vocabularies rather than re-grounded.

DOCTRINE.
  * Skill proficiency is reified as a gufo:Relator (gmeow:SkillProficiency) that binds {agent} × {skill} × {level} × {scale} × {interval}, mirroring languages' gmeow:LanguageProficiency and reusing the same gmeow:ProficiencyScale / gmeow:ProficiencyLevel value vocabularies (Principle 6).
  * Flat-first: gmeow:hasSkill is the 80 % shortcut; promote to SkillProficiency when level, scale, temporal scope, or standpoint matters.
  * Credential verification is routed through gmeow:Attestation (attestation.ttl), already aligned to vc:VerifiableCredential; expertise supplies the credential content, attestation the signed envelope (Principle 4).
  * Endorsement of a skill claim is an attestation over a SkillProficiency; contested levels coexist as standpoint-indexed claims (Principle 9).
  * Occupation classification codes (ESCO, SOC, O*NET) are open literal values on gmeow:occupationClassification; resolution is solver-side (Principle 12).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/expertise>
